finalText:
Builds clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump changing shapes:

1. `src/core/options.js:7` — read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — strict boolean check threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the "screen full of warnings" (deprecation notices, tree-shaking notes, dedupe lines) is just noise baked into the bundler's new verbose output — not actionable.
